facts.business: Autofurnish Limited sells automotive accessories and goods, including to its wholly owned subsidiary Golden Mace Private Limited.
key_risks: Borrowings increased compared with shareholders' funds
Equity increased and net profit was lower relative to the enlarged base
Inventory increased during the year, resulting in lower turnover
Trade receivables increased significantly compared with revenue growth
Working capital increased faster than revenue from operations
facts.related_party_note: Sale of automotive accessories/goods by Autofurnish Limited to Golden Mace Private Limited (wholly owned subsidiary) during FY 2025-26: ₹76.09 lakh (₹7,609.13 thousand) on commercial terms consistent with arm's length basis in the ordinary course of business.
